Raw hex address 0x1d81080 assigned to bare local `pCVar4`. The decompiler dropped a symbolic reference — either a data-symbol pointer (recover the symbol from the .asm and replace `pCVar4` with symbolic global/array indexing, §11) or a dead code-address store from return-address tracking (delete it, §14). Magic addresses do not survive the relink.
